title: 5.1 Fruits
unit_outcome: Name food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, talk about meals, ask prices and order politely at a café or market.
goal: Name six fruits and say who is eating them: Die Frau isst einen Apfel.
grammar_function: Das ist eine Banane. Subject + isst/essen + ein/eine/einen + fruit.
speaking_outcome: Name fruits and say who eats them.
